methodology.note: FPS is never converted directly to token count; token counts come from the provider's own usage fields (Ollama /api/generate prompt_eval_count/eval_count), already captured per-run in results.json.

aggregate.model_inference_latency_p50_p95: NOT_SEPARATELY_MEASURED (this harness times the full decide() call - HTTP + JSON + inference together; no isolated model-only timer exists)
aggregate.deadline_miss_rate: NOT_APPLICABLE (no per-decision deadline is defined for the local-Ollama baseline lane)
aggregate.interpretation: RTF << 1 across all seeds: this local 3B model on this M1 Pro box runs roughly 8-12x slower than real-time (mean RTF 0.106). Not real-time capable as configured.

local_ollama_baseline.note: Local inference has no metered API cost. Real-world electricity/compute cost exists but no pricing model was supplied for it; treated as out of scope, not fabricated as $0-means-free-forever.

hosted_jev.reason: Zero hosted-JEV runs executed (TYPESAFE_API_KEY absent), so there is no real JEV token usage to cost. Projecting a JEV cost using llama3.2:3b's token counts would violate the rule against using one provider's tokenizer for another (different tokenizers, different token/decision ratios) - not computed.

public_pricing_reference_only.source: Provided by the operator's task instructions; NOT independently re-verified against an official TypeSafe pricing page in this session (no web-fetch/browsing tool was available to this session).
public_pricing_reference_only.label: PROJECTED_COST_USING_PUBLIC_PRICE would require real JEV token counts, which do not exist. This figure is recorded for reference only and is not applied to any cost calculation here.

system_one_official_baseline.reason: BLOCKED_NO_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL; never executed, no token usage exists.

cost.score_per_dollar: NOT_APPLICABLE, same reason; secondary metric per spec, not computed given no comparable metered lane executed

pareto_note: Only one executed lane (local-Ollama baseline) exists; a genuine Pareto frontier requires 2+ comparable lanes with cost/quality/latency tradeoffs. With a single lane, no frontier can be meaningfully plotted or claimed. See figures/competition/ for the single-lane scatter prepared as a component for when additional lanes become available.
claim_ceiling: All real-time/cost figures above are measured from actually-executed local-Ollama runs. No hosted-JEV or official System-One cost or performance figure is claimed.
